recurring_disclosure_gate.prohibited_inference: No post-cutoff report existence, title or continued field availability was used.

product_contract_decision.rule: Do not create or impute D3_PRODUCT_VOLUME from D2 sales volume when recurring cutoff-before whole-issuer production throughput is unavailable.

cutoff_before_materiality_anchor.threshold_rule: H-A requires one annual recovery step above the FY2015 baseline; H-B requires the same step below it. The impairment is a cutoff-before capital-at-risk anchor, not a cash outflow to deduct again.

measurement_rules.required_observation: implementation or reversal of the six-brewery production closure, equivalent capacity rebuild, material supply interruption and transition burden inside the consolidated listed issuer

recurring_identity.unit: categorical plus disclosed capacity in 10k_kl when available
recurring_identity.expected_official_document_type: CNINFO annual report or original plant/capacity announcement
recurring_identity.cutoff_before_evidence: FY2015 annual report identifies six completed production-business closures

measurement_rules.required_observation: FY2016 recurring annual headline beer sales volume and consolidated revenue per headline kl

diagnostic_observation_guide.primary_context: sales volume decline is less severe than FY2014's 12.85% decline and revenue per headline kl is at least RMB3,359.0149
diagnostic_observation_guide.rival_context: sales volume decline is at least as severe as FY2014's 12.85% decline or revenue per headline kl falls below RMB3,359.0149

recurring_identity.metric: annual headline beer sales volume and consolidated operating revenue
recurring_identity.disclosure_change_risk: Product-table volume cannot silently replace the recurring headline volume; separately disclosed commissioned processing needs an issuer bridge.

measurement_rules.required_observation: FY2016 whole-issuer operating-contribution amount: consolidated revenue less consolidated operating cost, taxes and surcharges, selling expense and administrative expense

recurring_identity.metric: whole-issuer operating-contribution amount after taxes and surcharges
recurring_identity.segment_perimeter: whole consolidated issuer for every formula component; no product-volume denominator and no plant or brand allocation
recurring_identity.disclosure_change_risk: FY2015 moved supply-chain expense from administrative expense to manufacturing cost. The whole-issuer amount includes both accounts plus recurring taxes and surcharges; standalone gross margin and beer-volume denominators are non-central.

prohibited_substitutes: operating contribution divided by beer sales volume

measurement_rules.required_observation: FY2016 whole-issuer owner cash after removing any positive cash-working-capital release

recurring_identity.metric: consolidated OCF less all cash paid to acquire fixed, intangible and other long-term assets and less positive release between opening and ending five-account cash working capital
recurring_identity.disclosure_change_risk: Opening and ending cash-working-capital accounts and the long-term-asset-acquisition cash-flow caption must remain bridgeable at the issuer perimeter; otherwise return MEASUREMENT_MISMATCH or UNKNOWN.

prohibited_substitutes: OCF less capex without removing positive working-capital release

measurement_rules.required_observation: FY2016-FY2018 cumulative OCF less maintenance-oriented capital expenditure, with working-capital change, closure-related permanent loss/disposal proceeds and opening/average operating capital explicitly bridged

diagnostic_mode.numerator: cumulative owner cash after maintenance-oriented capital expenditure and permanent closure loss without double deduction
diagnostic_mode.denominator: opening and average consolidated operating capital with closure/disposal bridge
diagnostic_mode.reason: The cutoff-before packet does not support a non-arbitrary three-year capital-return threshold, and closure impairments cannot be treated as both a cash outflow and an additional capital loss.

recurring_identity.metric: consolidated cash flow, capital expenditure, operating assets and closure-related impairment/disposal bridge
recurring_identity.expected_official_document_type: CNINFO official audited annual report and original asset impairment/disposal announcement
recurring_identity.disclosure_change_risk: Maintenance versus expansion capex may remain UNKNOWN; no arbitrary allocation is allowed.

production_throughput_boundary.reason: No exact, repeated whole-issuer production-volume, sell-through or capacity-utilization identity exists across FY2013-FY2015 cutoff-before annual reports.
production_throughput_boundary.review_consequence: The current five-layer product contract makes D3_PRODUCT_VOLUME optional. R-104 therefore keeps production throughput UNKNOWN, does not register a product-volume claim and gives it no vote.

joint_hypothesis_comparison.primary: D3 operating contribution >= RMB272,368,979.53 AND D4 owner cash excluding positive working-capital release >= RMB237,216,601.66
joint_hypothesis_comparison.strongest_rival: D3 operating contribution <= RMB190,588,990.23 AND D4 owner cash excluding positive working-capital release <= RMB155,436,612.36
joint_hypothesis_comparison.simple_baseline: D3 operating contribution point RMB231,478,984.88; D4 owner cash excluding positive working-capital release point RMB196,326,607.01
joint_hypothesis_comparison.baseline_distinction: Each H-A and H-B amount boundary is one annual RMB40,889,994.65 recovery step away from the FY2015 point. The step is 20% of disclosed six-plant fixed-asset impairment and the primary cannot be met by merely repeating the baseline.

resolution.A_ONLY: both D3 and D4 satisfy their primary tests
resolution.B_ONLY: both D3 and D4 satisfy their rival tests
resolution.MIXED: the observed central discriminators conflict or occupy a frozen middle interval
resolution.NOT_DIAGNOSTIC: either central discriminator is UNKNOWN, MEASUREMENT_MISMATCH or otherwise unavailable

joint_hypothesis_comparison.anti_conflation_rule: D1 closure continuation and D2 sales-volume/price-mix observations are diagnostic context only. Optional D3 product throughput remains UNKNOWN and cannot be copied from D2. D5 remains continuous and cannot vote on the selection.

observed_inputs_required: D4 owner cash excluding positive working-capital release RMB
baseline_resolution.loss_function: Report predicate-wise absolute relative point error with no aggregate score. Missing or mismatched components remain NOT_DIAGNOSTIC.
baseline_resolution.interpretation_limit: Baseline error cannot create or reverse the H-A/H-B joint verdict. It only establishes whether the selected mechanism added a genuinely different operating call beyond last-observed continuation.
